provider: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem — Robert H. Smith Faculty of Agriculture, Food and Environment (International School)
scholarship_name: International MSc scholarships 2027–28 (MSc in Nutritional Sciences / MSc in Animal Sciences)
coverage_amount: Full scholarship per one official page: tuition, on-campus dormitory housing, medical insurance, monthly living stipend and student visa. Another official page says recipients still pay the application fee, visa fees, round-trip airfare, initial living expenses (1.5 months) and a tuition deposit
eligibility: Candidates from economically developing (and transitioning) countries; limited number of scholarships, very competitive; 2027–28 cohort is Nutrition and Animal Sciences (non-thesis)
notes: Applications with a scholarship: 1 Dec 2026 – 31 Mar 2027; self-funded deadline 31 Jul 2027
